name: Codex CLI
toolNameForm: each server is one Responses API namespace `mcp__<server>` holding function tools named by the tool; hooks still see the flat `mcp__<server>__<tool>` (V, rust-v0.164.0 core/src/tools/handlers/mcp.rs#L145, #L565; PR #17404, commit 0df7e9a8, 15 Apr 2026). Rules case 21
nameMangling: server and tool names: every character outside [A-Za-z0-9_] becomes _; collisions get _ plus 12 hex of SHA-1; namespace + name capped at 128 bytes (V, codex-mcp/src/tools.rs#L113-L237). Server names in config allow [A-Za-z0-9-_:@/.] (V, cli/src/mcp_cmd.rs#L1144)
listChanged: behind feature mcp_tool_list_changed, under development and off by default: tools do not refresh (V, features/src/lib.rs#L1598 at rust-v0.164.0)
notes: codex mcp add (0.163.0) appends `[mcp_servers.<name>]` with a blank line before it, keeps comments and other keys, and silently replaces an existing name (V, recorded). `--env K=V` writes the value literally into `[mcp_servers.<name>.env]`, so tk passes variables by name instead: `env_vars = ["NAME"]`, and `env_http_headers` / `http_headers` tables for headers; `codex mcp get` (0.163.0) reads all three back (V, run 27 Oct). Codex ignores unknown keys in an entry silently (V, run), so a misspelt key fails open; tk writes only these keys. An entry can also carry `http_headers_helper`, a program Codex runs; tk never writes it. At rust-v0.164.0 the source has deny_unknown_fields on RawMcpServerConfig (config/src/mcp_types.rs#L373), which disagrees with the 0.163.0 run that accepted an unknown key; tk writes only known keys either way. CODEX_HOME must name an existing folder (utils/home-dir/src/lib.rs#L5-L17). No ${VAR} interpolation exists in Codex config (NF); variables are named through env_vars, bearer_token_env_var and env_http_headers (V). When Codex rewrites the file it sorts env and header tables by key and replaces a non-inline server table whole (V, core/src/config/edit/document_helpers.rs).
